title: Anatolia Unveils Sintered Slab Innovation Center in Italy
excerpt: A state-of-the-art 300,000 sq ft manufacturing facility combining sustainable electric kilns with patented 3D veining precision.
content:
Anatolia is proud to announce the grand opening of its flagship Sintered Slab Innovation Center in Sassuolo, Italy. Engineered to meet the growing demand for large-format continuous veined surfaces, the plant features 100% zero-water waste recycling and solar-powered continuous pressing technology.

Architects and interior designers can now specify continuous vein-matched 6mm and 12mm sintered slabs with custom honing and polish finishes.

title: Milan Design Week 2026: The Serene Earth Pavilion
excerpt: Experience Anatolia's immersive installation featuring vein-cut Travertine Instrata and backlit Onyx Halo slabs.
content: Join Anatolia at Salone del Mobile / Milan Design Week 2026. Designed in collaboration with world-renowned architectural studio Studio V, the 'Serene Earth' pavilion presents a sensory exploration of stone surfaces inspired by natural geological formations.

title: Sustainable Porcelain Manufacturing: Zero Waste Futures
excerpt: How closed-loop water filtration and recycled raw materials are defining Anatolia's eco-certified tile series.
content: Sustainability is deeply embedded in every step of Anatolia's manufacturing process. From sourcing raw minerals near production hubs to utilizing 100% recycled greywater, we ensure high durability without compromising ecological integrity.
